 class DurableIntent:
-    """One fixed operation burn, created and directory-fsynced before any key."""
+    """Fixed main-VM lifetime root; one boot/job burn before any key.

+    """
     def __init__(self, directory):
         self.path = Path(directory)
+        need(self.path == ARCH_ROOT / "main-input-intents", "fixed-lifetime-intent-root")
+        self.parent_fd = os.open(ARCH_ROOT, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
+        parent = os.fstat(self.parent_fd)
+        need(stat.S_ISDIR(parent.st_mode) and parent.st_uid == os.getuid()
+             and not stat.S_IMODE(parent.st_mode) & 0o022
+             and identity(parent) == identity(ARCH_ROOT.lstat()), "intent-root-parent")
+        self.parent_identity = identity(parent)
         info = self.path.lstat()

         self.identity = identity(os.fstat(self.fd))
 
     def burn(self, record):
